result.title: Structure-Aware Matching for Robust UAV Thermal-to-Satellite Geo-Localization
result.summary: UAV thermal-to-satellite geo-localization localizes UAVs by matching real-time thermal images against georeferenced satellite images, enabling autonomous navigation in GNSS-denied and low-visibility conditions. However, substantial cross-modal disparities in color, brightness and viewpoint hinder conventional appearance-based methods from establishing reliable correspondences. While existing approaches predominantly address global modality shifts, they overlook the invariant scene structures inherently shared between thermal and satellite views. To bridge this gap, we propose SAMF, a Structure-Aware Matching Framework that explicitly exploits stable cross-modal structural cues to improve UAV thermal geolocalization. Specifically, the Directional Structure Enhancement Module (DSEM) strengthens robust structural representations by capturing directional and low-frequency spatial patterns, and the Modality-Aware Affine Remapping Module (MARM) subsequently applies affine correction to these enhanced features, further promoting cross-modal alignment. Additionally, we introduce the Thermal-UAV-Paired benchmark derived from the Thermal-UAV dataset. Extensive experiments on both the Boson-nighttime and Thermal-UAV-Paired datasets show that SAMF achieves state-of-the-art performance. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness and synergistic complementarity of DSEM and MARM. The code and dataset are released at: https://github.com/YuxinWang879/SAMF.git.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SAMF 结构感知匹配框架，通过方向结构增强与模态仿射重映射两个模块提升无人机热成像与卫星图像之间的跨模态地理定位性能，并构建了 Thermal-UAV-Paired 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属跨模态图像匹配与视觉定位工程，虽涉及跨模态结构对齐，但未涉及推理状态生成与更新、latent 表示的使用或证据决策，与 LVR/VLM 推理主线缺乏可核查的具体联系。
